title: AARO's MFR marks Borland's triangle sighting unclassified and moves the rest into a SAP
summary: Dylan Borland tells of AARO's MFR marks Borland's triangle sighting unclassified and moves the rest into a SAP, about 2023 at AARO, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: AARO left the Langley triangle sighting unclassified

plain: Dylan Borland, a former Air Force member, says that in 2023 he gave testimony to AARO, a Pentagon office set up to look into reports of unexplained objects, and that they wrote up a memorandum for record, an official written summary of his account. He says the summary listed his sighting of a triangle-shaped craft as unclassified, but classified his other drawings of technologies of unknown origin, moving them into a special access program, a tightly restricted secret project. He takes that split as proof that the government considers what he saw real and sensitive.
